选择任务，记录结果与反馈、分析原因并填写改进措施。: Select a task, record results and feedback, analyze causes, and propose improvements.
各任务分别保存复盘草稿，切换任务不会丢失输入。: Each task has its own review draft. Switching tasks preserves your input.
关联任务已不可访问，请重新选择任务。: The linked task is unavailable. Select another task.
复盘已保存。计划调整需另行预览和确认。: Review saved. Plan changes require a separate preview and confirmation.
记录已完成的工作和实际结果: Record completed work and actual results
说明影响结果的因素与待核对项: Explain contributing factors and points to verify
明确调整方法和效果检查方式: Specify the change and how to check its effect
完成了哪些工作？有哪些产物？哪些由你负责？: What work did you complete, what did you produce, and which parts were your responsibility?
虚构示例，仅供参考，不会填入你的记录。: Fictional example for reference. It will not be inserted into your records.
草稿预览 · 尚未应用到计划: Draft preview · not applied to the plan
尚未填写改进措施。请说明下一次准备调整的做法。: No improvements entered. Describe what you plan to change next time.
此任务尚未保存结果，请填写实际完成的工作。: This task has no saved results. Record the work you actually completed.
查看已保存的复盘，修订时保留原版本。: View saved reviews. Revisions retain the original version.
暂无复盘记录。完成实践后，可记录结果、原因和改进措施。: No saved reviews. After a practice task, record results, causes, and proposed improvements.
请填写实际结果、原因分析和改进措施后再保存。: Enter actual results, cause analysis, and proposed improvements before saving.
选择复盘重点，查看对应的填写示例。: Choose a review focus to see a relevant writing example.
哪些做法有效？取得了什么结果？: Which approaches worked, and what results did they produce?
这些做法为什么有效？哪些原因还需核对？: Why did these approaches work? Which explanations need verification?
下次准备沿用哪些做法？: Which approaches will you use again?
记录具体行动、产物和本人负责的部分。: Record specific actions, outputs, and your own contribution.
说明方法、材料或协作对结果的影响；尚未验证的解释标为推测。: Explain how methods, materials, or collaboration affected results. Mark unverified explanations as tentative.
遇到了什么问题？对结果有什么影响？: What problems occurred, and how did they affect the results?
哪些因素导致了问题？哪些还只是猜测？: Which factors caused the problem? Which are still assumptions?
准备如何解决这个问题？: How do you plan to address this problem?
记录问题发生的环节、具体表现和未完成的内容。: Record where the problem occurred, what happened, and what remains unfinished.
检查输入、方法、任务范围和协作，说明具体影响因素。: Check inputs, methods, scope, and collaboration to identify contributing factors.
写明具体调整及验证方式，实施后的效果另行记录。: Specify the change and how to verify it. Record its effect after implementation.
收到了哪些反馈？对应哪些工作或产物？: What feedback did you receive, and which work or output does it concern?
准备如何处理反馈？怎样检查调整效果？: How will you address the feedback and check the effect of your changes?
明确要处理的反馈、修改内容和复查方式。: Identify the feedback to address, the changes to make, and how to review them.
选择任务，查看交付要求、执行状态和已保存的结果。: Select a task to view its delivery requirements, status, and saved results.
填写任务目的和预期产物，创建前检查范围与每周预算。: Enter the task purpose and expected output. Check scope and weekly budget before creating it.
根据实际结果和反馈，分析原因并填写改进措施。: Analyze actual results and feedback, then propose improvements.
尚未保存产物或结果。完成任务后，可在此查看记录。: No saved outputs or results. Records will appear here after you save your work.
可对已完成的部分进行复盘，无需等待全部任务结束。: You can review completed work before the entire task is finished.
暂无提交版本。可先保存草稿，完成后再提交。: No submissions yet. Save a draft and submit when ready.
本次任务范围已记录完成: Task completion recorded for the defined scope
所需记录已齐，可确认完成: Required records are complete. You can confirm completion.
结果与反馈、原因分析和改进措施。: Results and feedback, cause analysis, and proposed improvements.
草稿已保存在本机；点击“保存并核对经历”后，逐项确认原文。: Draft saved on this device. Select “Save and review experience” to check each item.
填写实际经历，保存后逐项核对原文；缺少的信息可稍后补充。: Enter your actual experience, then save and review each item. Add missing information later.
请先保存复盘记录，再进入职业报告。: Save your review before opening the career report.
分步填写经历或粘贴原文，再填写标题。保存后逐项核对，此时记录仍待确认。: Fill in the experience step by step or paste existing text, then add a title. Save to review each item; the record remains unconfirmed.
补录实际发生的作业、练习或交流记录后，即可填写复盘。: Add an actual assignment, exercise, or conversation record to start a review.
当前任务暂无复盘，可切换至全部复盘查看。: No review for this task. Switch to all reviews to see other records.
开始或继续所选任务；受阻或暂停时，先处理阻塞或核对安排。: Start or continue the selected task. Resolve blockers or review the schedule for blocked or paused tasks.
选择任务，填写实际结果、原因分析和改进措施后保存。反馈为选填。: Select a task, enter actual results, cause analysis, and improvements, then save. Feedback is optional.
查看工作内容、技能工具和我的成果。: Explore work details, skills and tools, and your own work.
至少选择两个方向后可查看比较: Select at least two careers to compare.
至少选择两个岗位后可比较: Select at least two jobs to compare.
选择2至3个岗位后，可比较职责与条件；不生成企业文化星级或综合匹配分。: Select two or three jobs to compare responsibilities and requirements. No culture ratings or overall match scores are generated.
对比工作内容、所需技能和典型产物。: Compare daily work, required skills, and typical outputs.
选择2–3个方向后，可查看比较。: Select 2–3 directions to view a comparison.
已选1个方向，再选1个即可比较。: One selected. Select one more to compare.
已选2个方向，可查看比较或再选1个。: Two selected. Compare now or add one more.
已选3个方向；取消一项后可更换。: Three selected. Uncheck one to choose another.
选择职业方向进行比较，或添加已有经历。: Compare career directions or add your experience.
查看待处理事项、当前任务和本周安排。: Review pending items, current tasks, and this week’s schedule.
复查变化的材料与引用，再确认需要更新的分析范围。: Review changed materials and references, then confirm which analysis to update.
核对原文与本人贡献后，再将材料用于职业准备分析。: Review the original text and your contribution before using the materials in a preparation analysis.
对照职业要求，检查已有材料与待补充内容。: Review existing materials and missing information against career requirements.
比较职业方向与处理当前事项: Compare careers and manage current work
选择2–3个职业方向，或打开待处理材料和当前任务。: Select 2–3 career directions, or open pending materials and current tasks.
职业比较、本人确认材料与实际任务记录。: Career comparisons, self-confirmed materials, and actual task records.
勾选只保存比较候选；目标、材料确认和任务创建仍需另行操作。: Checking a direction saves a comparison candidate. Setting a goal, confirming materials, and creating a task require separate actions.
勾选2–3个职业方向。选择只保存比较候选，不会更改主目标。: Check 2–3 career directions. This saves comparison candidates without changing your main goal.
点这里查看所选方向的工作内容、技能与典型产物。: Open the comparison to review daily work, skills, and typical outputs for the selected directions.
点击对应入口，核对材料、处理变化或继续当前任务。: Use this action to review materials, address changes, or continue the current task.
核对IT 实施交付的准备情况: Review preparation for IT implementation and delivery
查看工作条件、专业材料、本人贡献与复盘的记录状态。: Review recorded work conditions, professional materials, personal contributions, and reviews.
四段等长 · 非能力评分: Four equal segments · Not an ability score

每段对应一项活动任务，宽度按预计投入计算。: Each segment represents an active task, sized by estimated effort.
汇总职业选择、材料依据和行动记录，核对后保存阶段版本。: Review career choices, supporting materials, and action records, then save a stage version.
材料数量表示记录分布，不表示能力水平。: Counts describe record distribution, not ability.
暂无材料记录，可从已有经历开始整理。: No material records yet. Add an experience to begin.
个版本；状态不代表能力核验。: versions; status does not certify ability.
暂无任务记录，未生成未来成果或进度。: No tasks recorded. Future outcomes or progress are not generated.
本人关联，不表示满足岗位要求。: Your links do not confirm that job requirements are met.
无需岗位定向关联，按所选材料独立编排。: Arrange selected materials without job-specific links.
在编辑区选择确认经历或教育记录。: Select confirmed experience or education in the editor.
预计投入，不代表实际学习时长。: Estimated effort, not actual study time.
从课程项目、实习或自主作品开始，写清自己负责的部分，再逐项确认。: Record a course project, internship or personal work. Describe your own contribution, then review each item.
课程项目、实习与自主作品都可以记录。: Record a course project, internship or personal work.
可以回到计划查看暂停或取消的行动。: Open your plan to review paused or cancelled actions.
先预览范围、预计投入和交付物，再决定是否开始。: Review the scope, estimated effort and deliverables before starting.
回看已经记录的结果、反馈与调整。: Revisit recorded outcomes, feedback and adjustments.
整理选择理由与行动记录，保留阶段版本。: Keep a version of your decisions, reasoning and actions.
需要时再探索与比较，不必先确定方向。: Explore or compare when useful. You can choose a direction later.
选择一个对照方向，查看已有材料能支持什么，以及还需要验证什么。: Choose a career to review what your materials support and what still needs checking.
处理当前重点，接着已有记录继续: Focus on current work and continue your records
查看待确认材料、当前任务和每周可用时间；没有记录时可先整理经历或预览小实践。: Review pending materials, current tasks and weekly availability. Start by recording experience or previewing practice.
本人确认材料、实际行动记录与可回看的阶段版本。: Self-confirmed materials, recorded actions and saved versions.
首页只汇总已保存记录；进入页面不会自动确认材料、创建任务或改变目标。: This page summarizes saved records. Opening a page does not confirm materials, create tasks or change your goal.
点击主要入口，整理经历、核对材料或继续任务。也可以先预览小实践，方向不必先确定。: Use the main action to record experience, review materials or continue a task. You can also preview practice before choosing a direction.
